description: Links to download a surah's files: "text", the Arabic (optionally with a translation and the Tafsir al-Muyassar) as a .txt; "audio", its recording as an MP3 (leave out the surah for all of a reciter's); "timing", where each ayah and word of a recording starts and ends, as JSON; "font", the mushaf's fonts for the surah's pages (QCF V2, one a page) with the glyphs each ayah is written in; "data", for developers, the whole data sets (the Uthmani text, a translation or the tafsir in one file, the mushaf layout, word by word), with their sources.

reciter.description: For audio and timing: reciter id; defaults to the site's own

surah.description: Surah number, 1-114; needed for all but audio

tafsir.description: For text: the Tafsir al-Muyassar under each ayah

translation.description: For text: a translation id to put under each ayah, e.g. "hilali"; for data: the translation to give whole

name: get_file
title: Get a file
